location.en: A café near the language school
location.zh: 語言學校附近的咖啡廳

goal.en: Help Mia and Leo talk through their fight without taking sides.
goal.zh: 保持中立，幫米亞和里歐把爭執好好談開。

background: cozy café interior on a quiet afternoon, wooden tables with mismatched chairs, potted plants on the windowsill, warm pendant lamps, rain-streaked front window

intro.en: Saturday afternoon. You walk into the café and find Mia and Leo at the same table, carefully not looking at each other.
intro.zh: 星期六下午。你走進咖啡廳，看到米亞和里歐坐在同一桌，卻刻意不看對方。

intro.en: Oh good, Kai's here. Maybe Kai can explain to Leo why skipping the class picnic was rude.
intro.zh: 太好了，凱來了。也許凱可以跟里歐解釋，放大家鴿子不來野餐有多沒禮貌。

intro.en: I told you, I have an exam on Monday! Why is that so hard to understand?
intro.zh: 我說過了，我星期一要考試！這有那麼難懂嗎？

lines.en: Kai, you agree with me, right? He totally let me down.
lines.zh: 凱，你也站我這邊吧？他真的讓我很失望。

choices.en: Hold on. I can see both sides here. Can we talk it through?
choices.zh: 等一下。我覺得兩邊都有道理。我們好好談談？
choices.tip: I can see both sides. 表示你不選邊站，是調解的第一步。

choices.en: Yes, Leo was totally wrong. Leo, just say sorry to her now.
choices.zh: 對，里歐完全錯了。里歐，你現在就跟她道歉。

lines.en: Great. Two against one. I'm out of here.

story.en: Leo grabs his coffee and leaves. Mia feels great for about thirty seconds, then texts you asking how to fix it.
story.zh: 里歐拿起咖啡就走。米亞開心了大概三十秒，然後傳訊息問你該怎麼收拾。

fail.why: 調解時直接判定誰對誰錯，被判輸的人只會更防衛。先表明中立：I can see both sides here.。

choices.en: Hey, don't be noisy, both of you. We are all good friends.
choices.zh: 欸，你們兩個不要吵了，大家都是好朋友。

lines.en: Noisy? We're not that loud... are we?
lines.zh: Noisy？我們沒那麼大聲吧……有嗎？

story.en: Mia and Leo start whispering their argument instead. It is somehow even more intense.
story.zh: 米亞和里歐改成壓低聲音吵。不知道為什麼，氣氛反而更緊繃了。

fail.why: 中文的「吵」有「吵架」和「很吵」兩個意思，noisy 只表示音量大。叫人別吵架要說 Please don't fight. 或 Let's talk it through.。

lines.en: Fine. But she'll just say I don't care about her. Which isn't true.
lines.zh: 好啦。但她一定會說我不在乎她，根本不是這樣。

lines.en: Then why didn't you even text me?
lines.zh: 那你為什麼連一則訊息都不傳？

choices.en: Let's hear each other out. Mia, you go first, then Leo.
choices.zh: 我們先聽彼此把話說完。米亞先說，再換里歐。
choices.tip: hear each other out 是「聽對方把話說完」，讓雙方輪流發言能降溫。

choices.en: Okay, let's listen each other. Mia, you go first, then Leo.
choices.zh: 好，我們互相聽一下。米亞先說，再換里歐。

lines.en: Listen each other? You mean listen TO each other? Sorry, I've studied grammar all week.
lines.zh: Listen each other？你是說 listen TO each other？抱歉，我這週一直在念文法。

story.en: Mia and Leo team up to correct your grammar. It's the first thing they've agreed on all day, but the real problem is still on the table.
story.zh: 米亞和里歐聯手糾正你的文法。這是他們今天第一次意見一致，但真正的問題還擺在桌上。

fail.why: listen 是不及物動詞，後面要加 to 才能接受詞：listen to each other。更道地的說法是 Let's hear each other out.。

choices.en: Wait, should we order some cake first? I'm actually starving.
choices.zh: 等等，我們要不要先點個蛋糕？我其實好餓。

lines.en: Kai, seriously? The cake can wait.
lines.zh: 凱，你認真的嗎？蛋糕可以等。

story.en: You eat a slice of carrot cake in heavy silence. It's a very good cake. Nobody enjoys it.
story.zh: 你在沉重的沉默中吃完一塊紅蘿蔔蛋糕。蛋糕很好吃，但沒有人吃得開心。

fail.why: 兩人正在氣頭上時轉移話題，會讓人覺得你不在乎。先讓雙方輪流說話：Let's hear each other out.。

lines.en: I spent all week planning it. Then one hour before, Leo just... didn't show up. No message.
lines.zh: 我花了一整個禮拜籌備。結果前一個小時，里歐就……沒出現，連個訊息都沒有。

choices.en: That sounds really frustrating. You felt let down, right?
choices.zh: 聽起來真的很讓人沮喪。你覺得被放鴿子了，對吧？
choices.tip: 把對方的感受說出來（You felt let down），能讓人覺得被理解，又不用評斷誰對。

choices.en: Come on, Mia, it's just a picnic. Don't be so dramatic.
choices.zh: 拜託，米亞，只是個野餐而已，不要這麼誇張。

lines.en: Dramatic? Wow. Now I'm mad at both of you.
lines.zh: 誇張？哇喔。現在我兩個都生氣了。

title.en: Two for the Price of One

story.en: You came to solve one fight and accidentally started a second one. Mia changes your contact name to "Traitor."
story.zh: 你本來要平息一場吵架，結果意外開啟第二場。米亞把你的聯絡人名稱改成「叛徒」。

fail.why: Don't be so dramatic. 是在貶低對方的感受，調解時大忌。先承認情緒：That sounds really frustrating.。

choices.en: Let's just forget it and move on. Keeping the peace matters most.
choices.zh: 我們就當沒這回事吧，以和為貴最重要。

lines.en: Forget it? But I actually want to talk about it.
lines.zh: 當沒這回事？可是我是真的想把話說開。

story.en: Everyone pretends things are fine. Two weeks later, the same fight comes back, now with interest.
story.zh: 大家都假裝沒事。兩週後同樣的爭執又爆發，還連本帶利。

fail.why: 「以和為貴、當沒發生」在英語文化的朋友之間常被視為逃避，大家比較習慣把話說開。可以說 Let's talk it through.。

lines.en: I know I messed up the message part. But I was panicking about the exam. I didn't think.
lines.zh: 我知道沒傳訊息是我不對。可是我那時候在為考試恐慌，腦袋一片空白。

choices.en: That's fair. Stress makes anyone forget. Can you tell Mia that?
choices.zh: 有道理，壓力大誰都會忘東忘西。你可以直接跟米亞說嗎？
choices.tip: That's fair. 先肯定對方的理由，再引導他直接對另一方說，是中立調解的技巧。

choices.en: I understand. When I am stress, I also forget everything, you know.
choices.zh: 我懂。我壓力大的時候也會什麼都忘記。

lines.en: When you ARE stress? Like... you become stress itself?
lines.zh: 你「是」壓力？像是……你變成壓力本身？

story.en: Leo laughs so hard he forgets he's in a fight. Mia does not laugh. Mia remembers.
story.zh: 里歐笑到忘了自己在吵架。米亞沒有笑。米亞記得很清楚。

fail.why: stress 是名詞或動詞，形容「壓力很大」要用 stressed：When I'm stressed...。

choices.en: Mia, Leo has difficulties too. Can you give him some face, okay?
choices.zh: 米亞，里歐也有他的難處，你就給他點面子吧？

lines.en: Give him... my face? What does that even mean?
lines.zh: 給他……我的臉？這到底是什麼意思？

story.en: Mia pictures handing her face to Leo. The image is so strange that everyone forgets the argument for a moment, but nothing gets solved.
story.zh: 米亞想像把自己的臉交給里歐。畫面太詭異，大家一時忘了在吵什麼，但問題完全沒解決。

fail.why: 「給面子」直譯成 give face 英文母語者聽不懂，而且叫一方讓步也不中立。可以引導當事人自己說明：Can you tell Mia that?

lines.en: Mia, I'm sorry. I should've texted you. That wasn't okay.
lines.zh: 米亞，對不起。我應該傳訊息給你的，那樣真的不對。

lines.en: ...Okay. And I'm sorry I called you selfish. So, Kai, what now?
lines.zh: ……好啦。我也很抱歉罵你自私。那，凱，接下來呢？

choices.en: How about we redo the picnic after Leo's exam? My treat.
choices.zh: 等里歐考完，我們再辦一次野餐如何？我請客。
choices.tip: How about we...? 提出雙方都能接受的方案，讓和好有具體的下一步。

choices.en: How about we have picnic again after Leo finish his exam?
choices.zh: 等里歐考完試，我們再野餐一次怎麼樣？

lines.en: "After Leo finish"? Kai, I need good grammar karma before Monday.
lines.zh: 「After Leo finish」？凱，我星期一前需要好的文法運勢耶。

story.en: Leo jokingly blames your grammar for every wrong answer on his practice test. The picnic plan gets forgotten in the teasing.
story.zh: 里歐開玩笑地把模擬考的每個錯都怪到你的文法頭上。野餐計畫在打鬧中被忘光了。

fail.why: 主詞 Leo 是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 s：after Leo finishes。picnic 是可數名詞，要說 have a picnic。

choices.en: Great, problem solved. Next time, please don't drag me into it.
choices.zh: 很好，問題解決。下次拜託別把我扯進來。

lines.en: Wow. Sorry for bothering you, Kai.

story.en: Mia and Leo make up with each other and then both give you the silent treatment. Peace has been restored, just not for you.
story.zh: 米亞和里歐和好了，然後兩個一起不理你。和平恢復了，只是不包括你。

fail.why: 朋友和好的時刻抱怨被拖下水，會讓人覺得你很不情願。用一個溫暖的提議收尾：How about we...?

lines.zh: 成交。而且里歐負責帶甜點。

lines.en: Fair. Thanks, Kai. You'd make a great referee.
lines.zh: 公平。謝啦，凱。你很適合當裁判。

story.en: You didn't pick a side, and that's exactly why it worked. By the time the cake arrives, Mia and Leo are arguing about dessert instead.
story.zh: 你沒有選邊站，這正是成功的關鍵。蛋糕送來時，米亞和里歐已經改成在爭論要帶什麼甜點了。

notes.explain: 被朋友拉去選邊站時，這句能清楚表達中立，又不會讓任何一方覺得被否定。

example.en: I can see both sides, but let's hear the whole story first.
example.zh: 我覺得兩邊都有道理，不過先聽完整件事吧。

notes.zh: 我們先聽彼此把話說完。
notes.explain: hear someone out 是「聽某人把話說完、不打斷」。調解時讓雙方輪流說話，是降溫的關鍵。

example.en: Please hear me out before you say no.
example.zh: 在你拒絕之前，請先聽我說完。

notes.zh: 聽起來真的很令人沮喪。
notes.explain: 說出對方的感受（frustrating、let down），讓對方覺得被理解，但不代表你判定誰對誰錯。

example.en: You waited two hours? That sounds really frustrating.
example.zh: 你等了兩個小時？聽起來真的很讓人沮喪。

notes.explain: 中文「吵」有兩個意思。noisy 只表示聲音大；「吵架」要用 fight 或 argue。叫人別吵架說 Please don't fight.。

example.en: They argued about money last night.

notes.explain: 在英語文化的朋友之間，把問題攤開來談通常比「當作沒發生」更受重視。talk it through 是「從頭到尾好好談清楚」。

example.en: I'm still upset, but I want to talk it through.
example.zh: 我還是很難過，但我想把話說開。
